annotation.method: Codex reread the complete 23-page local paper, surveyed every labeled and numbered result, compared the candidates with the frozen Mathlib and NumStability baselines, and required compiling exact private N and L proofs before retaining any tier. The former full-Theorem-4.3 T1 was replaced by its explicit equation-(4.12) centered-error bound after the private and measured evidence showed that unrelated shared work obscured the one library shortcut.
annotation.reason: The project owner assigned the P17 source selection and benchmark annotation to Codex.

corpus_membership: This paper is part of the current corpus listed in metadata/manifest.json.
paper_version: published journal version; SIAM Journal on Scientific Computing 47(5), 2025, pages B1227-B1249

rejected_candidates.candidate: Definitions 2.2, 2.5, 2.7, and 2.9 and the floating-point model in Section 2
rejected_candidates.reason: These are definitions or recalled preliminaries rather than results proved in this paper.
These probability facts are recalled from the literature. P17-T1 formalizes their paper-specific use in Theorem 4.3.
The conditional-bias identity is central supporting material used by the selected Lemma 3.10 task rather than a standalone benchmark result.
This technical algebraic lemma is included as supporting material in P17-T3's formalization of Lemma 3.10 rather than selected alone.

The published product-envelope statement omits sign assumptions required by its proof. The former project-corrected target was not a theorem stated by the paper and was removed rather than retained as an artificial task.

Theorem 4.2 uses an externally delegated martingale construction, while the inner-product results repeat the same bias and probability pattern with one multiplication error. Theorems 4.1 and 4.3 provide the clean summation progression.

This was the former P17-T1, but the exact N/L proofs and three measured pairs show that the substantial Chebyshev shortcut is obscured by the common recursive-sum expansion and deterministic remainder proof. It does not give L a sufficiently clear T1 advantage.

rejected_candidates.candidate: Remark 5.1 random-bit rule and the experiments in Section 6
rejected_candidates.reason: The random-bit choice is explicitly presented as a rule of thumb derived from asymptotic comparison, and the experiments are empirical rather than universally quantified formal results.

rejected_candidates.candidate: future extension to backward error analysis in Section 7
rejected_candidates.reason: The paper states this as future work, not a completed result.

T1.decision: Use the centered-error probability bound explicitly numbered (4.12) in the proof of Theorem 4.3. Exact private N/L proofs isolate one substantial finite-Chebyshev result: N reconstructs the finite tail argument, while L applies the library result.

T2.decision: Skipped after a fresh full-paper audit. The strongest probability-bound candidate receives one substantial finite Chebyshev result; its bias, variance, and product-history work is paper-specific rather than a second NumStability theorem. Other candidates have no two independent substantial library matches.

T3.decision: Use Lemma 3.10's centered mean-independence result, power-set product decomposition (3.8), and sharp gamma-difference bound (3.9). The combined history-conditioned and combinatorial proof has no corresponding mounted result.

selection_policy: Use results proved in this paper rather than recalled probability facts, empirical plots, or future-work claims.
Expose finite products, finite summation conditioning, and finite probability with paper-scoped definitions.
Use exact finite inequalities rather than asymptotic big-O comparisons.
Keep every public definition free of NumStability imports.

Assign or retain a tier only after exact private N and L proofs compile and establish its required difficulty and library advantage. Compare only with the complete frozen NumStability source and compiled condition-L bundle recorded in metadata/library_olean.json.

source.page_map: PDF pages 1-23 are journal pages B1227-B1249 respectively.
source.rights_note: The local article copy states SIAM copyright and prohibits unauthorized reproduction. Release only bibliographic metadata, locators, hashes, and concise benchmark-author paraphrases unless redistribution permission is confirmed.

source_validity.benchmark_treatment: The contradicted Theorem 3.6 statement is excluded. P17-T3 instead uses Lemma 3.10 exactly as stated and proved in the paper.
